summary: Iteration 2 testing complete. All 19 backend pytest cases passed (Greeks for 5 strategies, Payoff for iron_condor/long_straddle, payoff scaling with lots, Backtest EXPIRY_5D vs TARGET_SL produce different results, Razorpay config/create-order/verify with valid HMAC flips user to Pro, verify with invalid signature returns 400, checkout HTML serves Razorpay JS, plus regression of all iteration-1 endpoints). Frontend mobile UI verified end-to-end: tapping strategy card opens modal with SVG PAYOFF AT EXPIRY chart, breakevens (BE: ₹22249, ₹22651), Max Profit/Max Loss/Spot tiles, NET GREEKS row (Δ/Γ/Θ/Vega); switching NIFTY→BANKNIFTY refreshes payoff & greeks; 'Backtest on 1Y History' button navigates to /backtest?strategyId=iron_condor&symbol=BANKNIFTY; Run Backtest renders equity curve (SVG) + full stats grid (Total P&L, Win Rate, Trades, Wins/Losses, Avg Win/Loss, Max Drawdown, Lots) and 'Recent Trades' rows; Profile→Pay ₹999 with Razorpay button navigates to /payment screen which presents 'Activate Pro' header with Razorpay Secure badge, ₹999 price, and embeds the hosted checkout via iframe loading /api/payments/checkout/{order_id} which in turn loads Razorpay's checkout iframe. Iteration-2 features fully working.

issues: Repeated console warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' from third-party lib (likely react-native-svg or gesture-handler); cosmetic only.

react_native_issues.issue: Same SDK version mismatches still present: @react-native-async-storage/async-storage@3.0.2 (expected 2.2.0), react-native-svg@15.15.5 (expected 15.12.1). Web/preview works; only affects native builds.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py has grown to ~1140 lines (greeks, payoff, backtest, payments all added). Still single-file; consider splitting into routers/{market,trades,greeks,backtest,payments}.py once it exceeds ~1500 lines.
Razorpay verify endpoint correctly uses hmac.compare_digest for constant-time signature comparison (good security practice).
Razorpay client init wrapped in try/except so backend doesn't crash if keys are missing — good.
Backtester historical_series is deterministic (seeded by symbol) — same backtest produces identical results across runs, which is correct for a 'simulated history' demo.
Greeks endpoint correctly applies sign based on BUY/SELL action and scales by qty=lots*lot_size — verified.
Payoff calculates 41 points across ±10% of spot, locates breakevens via linear interpolation between sign changes — verified breakevens match expected zones for Iron Condor.
MongoDB _id is consistently excluded via {'_id': 0} projection on all reads including new payment_orders collection.
Hosted checkout HTML correctly posts result via window.ReactNativeWebView.postMessage so the React Native WebView can intercept success/failure/dismiss events.

success_rate.backend: 100% (19/19 iteration-2 tests + all iteration-1 regression passes)
success_rate.frontend: 100% on tested flows (strategy modal, payoff chart, greeks row, symbol switch, backtest navigation + run, profile→payment→iframe checkout)

seed_data_creation: Created throwaway users (test_<uuid>, pay_<uuid>, reg_<uuid>, tester<ts>) and one Razorpay test order per run via /api/payments/create-order. All test data prefixed for easy cleanup. No production data modified.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration-2 pytest suite at /app/backend/tests/test_iteration2.py validates: Greeks (parametrized over all 5 strategies), Payoff (iron_condor positive max_profit & negative max_loss, long_straddle, lots-scaling), Backtest (stats keys + TARGET_SL≠EXPIRY_5D), Razorpay (config/create-order/checkout-html/invalid-sig=400/valid-HMAC→Pro). Valid HMAC is built locally with hmac.new(RAZORPAY_KEY_SECRET, f'{order_id}|{payment_id}', sha256).hexdigest() — no real test card needed. Frontend payment screen on web preview renders the hosted /api/payments/checkout/{order_id} inside an <iframe> (fallback path, since WebView is RN-only); Razorpay's own checkout iframe also loads. To trigger upgrade-pro-btn on Profile, use a fresh username (existing pro users see 'You are a PRO member' card instead). Run all backend tests with: pytest /app/backend/tests/ -v --junitxml=/app/test_reports/pytest/pytest_results.xml

Razorpay integration is correctly wired end-to-end: server uses official razorpay-python SDK to create real test orders against Razorpay's API, signs HMAC verification with key secret, and the hosted checkout HTML uses checkout.razorpay.com/v1/checkout.js. All iteration-2 features (Greeks, Payoff diagram, Backtester, Razorpay payments) work as specified.
